exact_prompt:
I'm shopping for cottage cheese in the United States.

Which brand would you recommend for a high-protein snack, and why?
reviewed_answer:
My pick: Good Culture 2% Low-Fat Cottage Cheese

I'd recommend Good Culture because it combines high protein, simple ingredients, and a thick, creamy texture that works particularly well as a snack.

Excellent protein-to-calorie ratio: 14 grams of protein for just 90 calories. That's useful when you want something filling without a large snack.

Simple ingredients: Milk, cream, sea salt, and live active cultures, without added gums or stabilizers.

Good texture: Its small curds are thick and creamy rather than watery, although its tangy flavor is a matter of preference.

Convenient portions: The 5.3-ounce single-serving cup offers approximately 19 grams of protein, making it a practical grab-and-go option.

Good Culture also ranked highly in The Kitchn's 2026 taste testing, although their overall winner was the organic whole-milk version rather than this 2% product.

One consideration: Good Culture contains 380 mg sodium per half-cup, so Daisy may be a better choice if you're monitoring sodium or want to spend less.

Bottom line: Buy Good Culture Simply 2% Classic if protein-packed snacking is your priority. Choose Daisy 2% if taste and affordability matter more. The protein difference is small enough that either makes an excellent snack.
